title: Higher Education Groups Oppose Trump Administration Proposed Rule to Remove “Deference” Policy
summary_en: ACE, others are asking DHS to withdraw its proposed rule ending the policy of deferring to earlier visa approvals in making decisions about H-1B extension requests.
